description: Let \((x_n)\) be a sequence in \((0,1)\), with canonical decimal digits \(x_n=0.d_{n0}d_{n1}\ldots\). Set \(e_n=2\) when \(d_{nn}=1\), and \(e_n=1\) otherwise. The decimal \(0.e_0e_1\ldots\) is canonical, lies in \([\frac19,\frac29]\subset(0,1)\), and differs from every \(x_n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalDiagonal_spec (x : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DecimalDigits)
  (_hx : ∀ (n : ℕ), x n ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hd : ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CanonicalDecimal (d n) ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue (d n) = x n) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalDiagonal d) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧
    1 / 9 ≤ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalDiagonal d) ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalDiagonal d) ≤ 2 / 9 ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CanonicalDecimal (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalDiagonal d) ∧
          ∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.decimalDiagonal d) ≠ x n
